name: CAPABILITY_SWITCH_AND_SCOPED_AUTHORITY_COMPOSITION
purpose: Define when semantic/proof authority carried by one exact carrier may be transported across an exact representation/capability switch into another carrier without silently widening readout/continuation scope, admitting source-unrealizable states, discharging debt for free, or laundering cost/provenance.

objects.source: Frozen relation/source identity F0 with concrete semantic state space Sigma_F.
objects.realization_relations: rho1 subset Sigma_F x C1 and rho2 subset Sigma_F x C2.
objects.switch_map: tau12 maps admitted C1 states/objects into C2 representations; it may be partial outside the authority-bearing reachable domain.

B1_ENDPOINT_AND_SOURCE_BINDING: A1 is ACTIVE for the exact use immediately before the switch.
A2 binds to the same frozen F0 unless an explicit source-equivalence theorem is part of the bridge.
Bridge endpoint digests exactly match A1 and A2.
B2_REACHABILITY_TRANSPORT: For every authority-bearing realized pair rho1(s,c1) used across the switch, c2=tau12(c1) must satisfy rho2(s,c2), OR A2 must contain an exact unreachable-state observational-irrelevance theorem sufficient for the target use.
Carrier grammar membership alone is insufficient.
The bridge must not create source authority for a C2 state that lacks both source lineage and an accepted irrelevance theorem.
B3_SCOPE_TRANSPORT: Authority is transferred only for a target scope explicitly covered by a checked scope-transport relation.
Let K1 and K2 be the continuation languages of A1 and A2. The bridge supplies either identity scope or an explicit continuation adapter kappa:K2->K1 plus readout adapter chi.
For every source state s relevant to the bridge and every k2 in K2 used after the switch, the bridge proves RF2(s,k2)=chi(RF1(s,kappa(k2))) and the corresponding carrier-side equality through tau12.
If no such adapter/equivalence proof exists, K2/Readout2 must be a literal sub-scope of the already certified A1 scope.
No target use may broaden Readout or Continuation merely because tau12 is semantics-preserving as a representation translation.
B4_PROOF_AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT: Every authority-bearing fact/certificate p1 imported from C1 must either be translated into a target proof p2 by a replayable proof translator bound to B12, or be independently revalidated under A2.
A proof object valid only in Proof1 cannot become Proof2 authority by serialization, hashing, naming, or semantic intuition.
Generic equivalence/tautology/SAT-oracle shortcuts forbidden by the inherited V1.1/Scoped-Authority firewalls remain forbidden.
B5_CAPABILITY_TRANSITION: The bridge does not grant capabilities. Every operation used after the switch must be licensed by Capability2.
A2 may be semantically adequate while Capability2 is UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED for a requested operation; in that case semantic authority survives but execution authority does not.
Preflight lower-bound/capability receipts may reject a switch before materialization without changing semantic debt.
B6_DEBT_COST_AND_PROVENANCE_TRANSFER: Pure authority transport changes neither semantic-debt status nor transformation-debt status.
Only separately certified discharge/execution/supersession subreceipts may move debt to certified status.
All already charged discovery/translation/materialization/verification work and liabilities are inherited monotonically.
Failed or superseded routes remain in provenance.
A C1->C2->C1 roundtrip cannot reset debt, cost, liabilities, or historical authority receipts.
B7_EXPIRY_AND_STALENESS: Any mismatch in source identity, reach contract, readout, continuation language, capability digest, proof contract, bridge version, or expiry rule makes the bridge/token authority STALE for the changed use.
Historical validity for the original scope remains unchanged.

scope_order.definition: A target authority use U2 is no broader than transported source authority U1 under B12 iff every target continuation/readout observation is mapped by the accepted ScopeTransport into an observation already certified by A1 and preserved by tau12.
scope_order.important_nonclaim: This is a scoped authority preorder for accepted uses, not a claim that C2 is globally less expressive than C1.

legal_switch_forms.REVALIDATE_AFTER_SWITCH: Translate representation exactly, then independently build/replay a fresh A2 token. No authority is imported except through fresh validation.
legal_switch_forms.PROOF_TRANSPORT_SWITCH: Use B12 ProofTransport to translate/replay selected proof facts from A1 into A2, under B2-B7.
legal_switch_forms.ATOMIC_SWITCH_AND_DISCHARGE: A switch may contain a separately verified semantic or transformation discharge. Only that named subreceipt changes debt; the switch itself has zero discharge authority.
legal_switch_forms.FAIL_CLOSED_SWITCH: If any bridge obligation is UNKNOWN, INVALID, out-of-scope, or stale, the switch may still be used as a heuristic representation experiment but carries no proof authority.

theorem_candidates.CS1_LOCAL_AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT: An admitted B12 transports an authority-bearing fact from ACTIVE A1 to ACTIVE A2 without losing source soundness for the declared target scope.
theorem_candidates.CS2_NO_SCOPE_WIDENING: Representation equivalence alone cannot authorize a target Readout/Continuation use outside U2<=_B U1. Such a use is STALE/NO_AUTHORITY until revalidated.
theorem_candidates.CS3_SWITCH_NONDISCHARGE_AND_NONFORGETFUL: Pure scoped-authority transport preserves both Dual-Debt partitions and accumulated charged history/provenance.
theorem_candidates.CS4_BRIDGE_COMPOSITION: If admitted B12:A1->A2 and B23:A2->A3 have exact endpoint identity and compatible scope/reach/proof transports, then their composition B13=B23 o B12 is an admitted bridge for the composed target scope; proof/reach maps and charged histories compose.
theorem_candidates.CS5_MULTI_LANGUAGE_TERMINAL_SOUNDNESS: A DD5/SA5 terminal trace containing a finite chain of admitted cross-scope bridges remains source-sound; no out-of-scope fact or source-unrealizable target state can acquire terminal authority merely by crossing languages.

composition_contract.endpoint_match: A2 digest produced/used by B12 must exactly equal the source token digest expected by B23.
composition_contract.source_match: The F0 binding is identical across the chain unless each source change is separately certified.
composition_contract.reach_composition: rho1(s,c1) -> rho2(s,tau12(c1)) -> rho3(s,tau23(tau12(c1))) or corresponding exact irrelevance theorems.
composition_contract.scope_composition: U3 <=_B23 U2 and U2 <=_B12 U1 imply U3 <=_(B23 o B12) U1 via composition of continuation/readout adapters.
composition_contract.proof_composition: Translated proofs are either replayed at each hop or a verified composed translator is supplied; opaque proof references are not transitively trusted.
composition_contract.debt_composition: Debt status is carried through all pure switches; only named accepted discharge receipts alter it.
composition_contract.cost_composition: Charged work is additive/monotone under composition; cached bridge receipts still incur lookup/replay cost.
composition_contract.associativity_note: Bridge composition is intended to be associative up to canonical receipt/provenance normalization when endpoint identities and adapters match; this is a corollary target, not required for CS1-CS5 soundness.

known: Proof-system p-simulation transforms proofs from one proof system to another with polynomial overhead when such a simulation is established.
Translation certification and translation validation certify individual compilation passes via explicit translation relations.
Proof compilers can translate programs, specifications and proof objects between source and target logics under formally proved conditions.
Full abstraction/contextual equivalence studies preservation of observations across compilation contexts.
Certified projected knowledge compilation checks representation transformations together with Skolem information.
prior_art_boundary.distinctive_candidate: The candidate under evaluation is not proof translation itself, but the integration of proof transport with explicit source-realizability scope, readout/continuation authority, capability staleness, Dual-Debt nonforgetfulness, and capability-scoped negative memory inside one solver lifecycle.
